name: slicc-serve
description: serve and scserve: publish a directory or a local server at a public capability URL through the SLICC tray hub, on any host and inside SLICC

scripts.lint: slicc-lint && shellcheck -s sh install.sh && dash -n install.sh && shellcheck scripts/*.sh && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p serve-core -p serve --target wasm32-wasip1 -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: node --check npm/scserve.js && node --check scripts/targets.mjs && node --check scripts/npm-stage.mjs && node --check scripts/npm-publish.mjs && node --check scripts/release-collect.mjs && node --check scripts/build-wasm.mjs
scripts.test:unit: mkdir -p coverage/unit && RUSTFLAGS='--cfg serve_unit' cargo llvm-cov --workspace --lcov --output-path coverage/unit/lcov.info --ignore-filename-regex '(crates/serve/src/|test/unit/|daemon\.rs|detach\.rs|cli\.rs|client\.rs|upgrade\.rs|open\.rs|ws\.rs|list\.rs|ttl\.rs|records\.rs|fsx\.rs|tray\.rs)'
